asks: Are you going to pour that away?
What did the last one put down here?
description: A throat, opening downward, fitted where a sink would be. It's damp and pink and moves a little, swallowing at intervals whether or not anything has been put into it.
emotes: {it} swallows, unprompted, and the sound carries.
{it} opens slightly wider and holds it.
{it} works at something and gives up on it.
looks: It swallows every so often, dry, and you can watch the whole length of the movement.
The rim is worn smooth and pale, the way a much-used thing goes.
There's a slow warm draught coming up out of it, and it smells of nothing at all.
name: a throat set in the wall
says: Anything you like. It all goes the same way.
I haven't been fed since this morning.
You're meant to run the tap first.
